facts: Parties: Delamere Bioscience plc (Buyer), Penrith Energy plc (Seller); the Company is Dunmore Medical Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 25 October 2026; Closing is scheduled for 16 December 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 20 days of becoming aware of it.
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 5 years after Closing.
Section 15.1: this Agreement is governed by English law and the courts of England have exclusive jurisdiction.

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 45 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.
Clause 12: this escrow agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York and disputes shall be referred to arbitration in New York.
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 12 months after termination of employment.
